title: Represent meaningful JD requirements
summary: Each requirement carries the original passage, plain interpretation, priority, meaningful child components, named technologies and unresolved interpretation.
body: Each requirement carries the original passage, plain interpretation, priority, meaningful child components, named technologies and unresolved interpretation. Separate distinct obligations such as retrieval, tool use and approval; do not create a requirement for every verb or noun.
